items.title: Agent OS – 0% Safety Violations for AI Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Agent OS treats LLMs like raw compute and provides OS-level governance. Current frameworks let the LLM "decide" whether to follow safety rules. Agent OS inverts this: the kernel decides, the LLM computes.

title_i18n.en: Agent OS – 0% Safety Violations for AI Agents
title_i18n.zh: Agent OS——AI代理零安全违规
title_i18n.es: Agente OS – 0% de Infracciones de Seguridad para Agentes de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Agent OS treats LLMs like raw compute and provides OS-level governance. Current frameworks let the LLM "decide" whether to follow safety rules. Agent OS inverts this: the kernel decides, the LLM computes.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Agent OS将大型语言模型视为原始计算资源，并提供操作系统级别的治理。现有框架让模型自行“决定”是否遵循安全规则，而Agent OS颠覆了这一模式：由内核决策，模型执行计算。
excerpt_i18n.es: Agent OS trata a los LLMs como potencia de cálculo en bruto y proporciona gobernanza a nivel de sistema operativo. Los marcos actuales permiten que el LLM "decida" si seguir las normas de seguridad. Agent OS invierte esto: el núcleo decide, el LLM calcula.

items.title: Taxplain – AI Tax Guidance That Explains Your Situation

Taxplain uses AI to answer tax questions in plain English across complex scenarios: crypto gains, self-employment, AMT, business structures, state-specific rules. It's like having a tax advisor in your pocket, powered by verified IRS documentation and tax code. The core insight: people don't want software—they want answers. We're targeting the DIY tax filer market that TurboTax underserves on guidance. Currently in beta. Would love feedback on the approach, the UX, or whether this solves a real problem for you. https://www.taxplain.xyz/

items.title: Ourguide – OS wide task guidance system that shows you where to click
items.raw_excerpt: Hey! I'm eshaan and I'm building Ourguide -an on-screen task guidance system that can show you where to click step-by-step when you need help. I started building this because whenever I didn’t know how to do something on my computer, I found myself constantly tabbing between chatbots and the app, pasting screenshots, and asking “what do I do next?” Ourguide solves this with two modes. In Guide mode, the app overlays your screen and highlights the specific element to click next, eliminating the need to leave your current window. There is also Ask mode, which is a vision-integrated chat that captures your screen context—which you can toggle on and off anytime -so you can ask, "How do I fix this error?" without having to explain what "this" is. items.title: AI code and software craft
items.raw_excerpt: Much has been said about audio, video and text "slop": low-quality, AI-generated content that has proliferated on the internet since the release of publicly-accessible AI models. Garbage content has always existed online, but the novelty of AI is that it has made its generation orders of magnitude less labor-intensive. For anyone who lacks a discerning eye, or is doing some task where discernment simply does not matter, AI has become a sufficient replacement for human hands.
